entries.tagline: Parametric CAD execution, exact geometry metrics and export
entries.description: Run parametric CAD scripts and get exact measurements: volume, surface area, center of mass, bounding box, and solid, face, and edge counts, computed analytically. Export STEP, STL, and GLB files as digest-bound resources, check assembly integrity, and project fixed 2D inspection views.

tools.name: build123d_execute
tools.summary: Execute a build123d Python script and return exact geometry metrics.
tools.inputs: A script assigning its final shape to `result`; optional material density for mass; optional timeout up to 60 s.
tools.results: Volume, area, center of mass, bounding box, and counts; optional mass. Mass is never guessed. No files.

tools.name: build123d_export
tools.summary: Execute a script and export the resulting shape.
tools.inputs: Script plus one or more formats (step, stl, gltf) and a base file name; optional density and timeout.
tools.results: The same metrics plus digest-bound artifact resources, read with resources/read rather than a host path.

tools.name: build123d_observe_assembly_integrity
tools.summary: Observe one STEP artifact with the fixed assembly integrity method.
tools.inputs: Digest-bound STEP bytes or a server-issued stepResource, exclusively. No code, path, tolerance, or transform.
tools.results: Factual import, unit, topology, and occurrence observations. Unknown facts stay unresolved or unavailable.

tools.name: build123d_project_2d
tools.summary: Project one STEP artifact into fixed SVG inspection views.
tools.inputs: Digest-bound STEP bytes or an owned STEP resource, exclusively. Optional mid-envelope section.
tools.results: Top, front, right, and isometric orthographic views. Visual inspection only; no dimensions.

examples.title: Measure a box
examples.summary: Run `result = Box(10, 10, 10)` and read volume 1,000 mm³ with 1 solid, 6 faces, and 12 edges.

examples.title: Export printable files
examples.summary: Run a script with formats step, stl, and gltf, then read the returned artifact URIs with resources/read.
